responsibility: Declares the small set of Xilinx embedded PowerPC command-line options handled by GCC. It adds flags controlling BSS clearing and use of the Xilinx performance library, integrating those switches into the rs6000 option parser so the Xilinx-specific specs in xilinx.h can react to them.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the same-stem header, this .opt file only declares the Xilinx-specific command-line switches and their parser properties, leaving the actual preprocessor, library, startup, and linker spec changes to xilinx.h.
